versions.content: If a P-port specified by a TriggerInterface is connected to an R-port with an incompatible interface and a TriggerInterfaceMapping for both interfaces is associated with the connection, the RTE of the ECU implementing the R-port shall map the trigger of the sender’s interface to the trigger of the receiver’s interface.
